stem: Which statement about a fixture dimmer percentage is most accurate?
choices: It directly equals PPFD in µmol m⁻² s⁻¹
It proves uniformity across the canopy
It is a fixture/control setting and should not automatically be treated as the canopy PPFD
It replaces the need for a measurement method
rationale: It is a fixture/control setting and should not automatically be treated as the canopy PPFD. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
